title: Ace Your Proposal/Dissertation Defense — Professor Explains
skills: present research findings clearly and confidently
explain research purpose, methods, evidence, and conclusions to an audience
respond thoughtfully to questions and challenges
defend claims using evidence, reasoning, and precise academic language
alignment_note: Although aimed at advanced academic proposal and dissertation defenses, this resource offers transferable strategies for presenting research, explaining methodology and conclusions, responding to questions, and defending evidence-based claims. It can serve as enrichment for high school research presentations, capstone projects, debates, and oral defenses.
